newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares cut early gains, end slightly off.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares cut early gains, end slightly off.

text.p: Brazilian stocks swept away early gains to close slightly lower Wednesday on profit-taking following Tuesday's rally, brokers said.
The Bovespa index of the 49 most active shares fell 0.1 percent to end at 65,432 points. Market volume was still high at 482.7 million reais ($469.8 million).
"The market took a breath today after yesterday's sharp rise," a senior trader said.

On Tuesday, the local market had interrupted a sequence of consecutive drops, boosted by fresh export figures that helped diminish worries over the country's growing trade deficit. Benchmark Telebras preferred ended flat at 76.60 reais. Mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce preferred fell 0.46 percent to close at 21.70 reais. percent to 129 reais.
The Sao Paulo bourse's power sector index rose 0.07 percent to 1,809 points. The index comprises the nine most liquid stocks of the electrical sector.
